hardware: managed Linux x64, AMD EPYC 9V45, about 9.7 GiB reported RAM

Baseline requests all precede candidate requests; not alternating pairs
CPU-only 8192 context differs from full application settings
Reference startup excludes application verification; candidate hashes full model
Small diagnostic does not establish agent quality or Max correctness/performance
Binary hashes identify the tested builds, not an attestation of the eventual PR head
